title: The Death of Yue Fei
synopsis: After the calamity of the Jingkang Incident, renowned general Yue Fei led the Song fightback against the Jin invaders, but the emperor was wary of his growing power.

series.title: The Splendor of the Song Dynasty

fullText.simplified:
岳飞之死——南宋复兴梦的终结

    杭州西湖山水如画，深受人们喜爱。除此以外，这里还有很多历史遗迹，包括四个特别的雕像。这四个雕像反绑双手，跪在西湖岳王庙里。岳王庙是纪念南宋民族英雄岳飞的地方，人们把当年害死他的人做成雕像，向他谢罪。
    岳飞，生于北宋末年。他自幼学习武术和兵法，性格宽厚仁慈。二十岁时，岳飞报名入伍，参与扫除贼寇的战斗。他表现英勇，初立战功。但不久后他的父亲去世，他离开军队，回乡为父守孝。两年后回到军队，次年北方金朝入侵宋朝。岳飞所在的军队从金军的围困中突围。随后，他回到家乡，亲眼看到老百姓被侵略者杀害、奴役。岳飞心中愤怒，想要投身救国，但又担心家中妻儿老小无人照顾。他的母亲鼓励他放弃个人私利，为国家做出贡献，并在他的后背刺下“尽忠报国”四个字。岳飞回到军队，表现非常突出，逐渐成为知名将领。
    金军一路南下。1127年，金军攻入宋朝首都汴京，掳走了皇宫中的皇帝，拥有167年历史的北宋灭亡。皇帝的弟弟赵构在河南商丘建立新的政权，开启南宋152年的历史，赵构是宋高宗。
    南宋国土远小于北宋，只剩下长江流域以南的国土了。岳飞一生的愿望都是收复北宋失地，恢复宋朝统一。他力主抗金，多次北上与金军浴血奋战。为了提升军队战斗力，岳飞训练了一支军队，人称“岳家军”。岳家军纪律严明，从不侵扰百姓，又能保卫国门，在民间的声望很高。但宋高宗不希望将领权力过大，就准备收回兵权。但岳飞希望皇帝能先允许他收复北方失地，这让皇帝产生了不安全感。另一方面，南宋有一些文官主张放弃北方失地，向金朝交钱换取和平。宋高宗陷入了矛盾，政策上也反复更改，对岳飞的北伐行动犹豫不决。
    但即使是在这样的背景下，岳飞仍然率领军队收复了部分土地，沉重打击了金军主力。在岳飞第四次北伐时，宰相秦桧在宋高宗的默许下，接连下诏召回岳飞。随后编造罪名，诬陷他谋反。岳飞拒不认罪，于狱中被冤杀，年仅39岁。岳飞死后，南宋抗金力量遭受重创，从此再也没能大规模收回北宋失去的领土。
    这就是岳飞的一生，后人将他视为英雄，将杀害他的直接凶手秦桧视为民族罪人。西湖岳王庙前那四个罪人的跪像，为首的就是秦桧。但事实上岳飞之死并不是秦桧与岳飞的个人恩怨，而是南宋政治斗争的产物。在国家危难之时，皇帝将个人利益置于民族利益之上，这种选择使南宋失去了复兴的机会，为后来的灭亡埋下了隐患。
fullText.traditional:
岳飛之死——南宋復興夢的終結

    杭州西湖山水如畫，深受人們喜愛。除此以外，這裡還有很多歷史遺跡，包括四個特別的雕像。這四個雕像反綁雙手，跪在西湖岳王廟裡。岳王廟是紀念南宋民族英雄岳飛的地方，人們把當年害死他的人做成雕像，向他謝罪。
    岳飛，生於北宋末年。他自幼學習武術和兵法，性格寬厚仁慈。二十歲時，岳飛報名入伍，參與掃除賊寇的戰鬥。他表現英勇，初立戰功。但不久後他的父親去世，他離開軍隊，回鄉為父守孝。兩年後回到軍隊，次年北方金朝入侵宋朝。岳飛所在的軍隊從金軍的圍困中突圍。隨後，他回到家鄉，親眼看到老百姓被侵略者殺害、奴役。岳飛心中憤怒，想要投身救國，但又擔心家中妻兒老小無人照顧。他的母親鼓勵他放棄個人私利，為國家做出貢獻，並在他的後背刺下“盡忠報國”四個字。岳飛回到軍隊，表現非常突出，逐漸成為知名將領。
    金軍一路南下。1127年，金軍攻入宋朝首都汴京，擄走了皇宮中的皇帝，擁有167年歷史的北宋滅亡。皇帝的弟弟趙構在河南商丘建立新的政權，開啟南宋152年的歷史，趙構是宋高宗。
    南宋國土遠小於北宋，只剩下長江流域以南的國土了。岳飛一生的願望都是收復北宋失地，恢復宋朝統一。他力主抗金，多次北上與金軍浴血奮戰。為了提昇軍隊戰鬥力，岳飛訓練了一支軍隊，人稱“岳家軍”。岳家軍紀律嚴明，從不侵擾百姓，又能保衛國門，在民間的聲望很高。但宋高宗不希望將領權力過大，就準備收回兵權。但岳飛希望皇帝能先允許他收復北方失地，這讓皇帝產生了不安全感。另一方面，南宋有一些文官主張放棄北方失地，向金朝交錢換取和平。宋高宗陷入了矛盾，政策上也反覆更改，對岳飛的北伐行動猶豫不決。
    但即使是在這樣的背景下，岳飛仍然率領軍隊收復了部分土地，沉重打擊了金軍主力。在岳飛第四次北伐時，宰相秦檜在宋高宗的默許下，接連下詔召回岳飛。隨後編造罪名，誣陷他謀反。岳飛拒不認罪，於獄中被冤殺，年僅39歲。岳飛死後，南宋抗金力量遭受重創，從此再也沒能大規模收回北宋失去的領土。
    這就是岳飛的一生，後人將他視為英雄，將殺害他的直接兇手秦檜視為民族罪人。西湖岳王廟前那四個罪人的跪像，為首的就是秦檜。但事實上岳飛之死並不是秦檜與岳飛的個人恩怨，而是南宋政治鬥爭的產物。在國家危難之時，皇帝將個人利益置於民族利益之上，這種選擇使南宋失去了復興的機會，為後來的滅亡埋下了隱患。

sentences.simplified: 另一方面，南宋有一些文官主张放弃北方失地，
sentences.traditional: 另一方面，南宋有一些文官主張放棄北方失地，
sentences.pinyin: lìng yì fāng miàn nán sòng yǒu yì xiē wén guān zhǔ zhāng fàng qì běi fāng shī dì
sentences.english: But Yue Fei hoped the emperor would first allow him to recover the lost northern territories, which made the emperor feel insecure.

sentences.simplified: 向金朝交钱换取和平。
sentences.traditional: 向金朝交錢換取和平。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng jīn cháo jiāo qián huàn qǔ hé píng
sentences.english: On the other hand, some civil officials of the Southern Song dynasty advocated abandoning the lost northern territories ..

sentences.simplified: 宋高宗陷入了矛盾，政策上也反复更改，对岳飞的北伐行动犹豫不决。
sentences.traditional: 宋高宗陷入了矛盾，政策上也反覆更改，對岳飛的北伐行動猶豫不決。
sentences.pinyin: sòng gāo zōng xiàn rù le máo dùn zhèng cè shang yě fǎn fù gēng gǎi duì yuè fēi de běi fá xíng dòng yóu yù bù jué
sentences.english: .. and paying tribute to the Jin dynasty in exchange for peace.
Emperor Gaozong of Song was caught in a dilemma, repeatedly changing policies, and was indecisive about Yue Fei’s northern expedition.

sentences.simplified: 但即使是在这样的背景下，岳飞仍然率领军队收复了部分土地，沉重打击了金军主力。
sentences.traditional: 但即使是在這樣的背景下，岳飛仍然率領軍隊收復了部分土地，沉重打擊了金軍主力。
sentences.pinyin: dàn jí shǐ shì zài zhè yàng de bèi jǐng xià yuè fēi réng rán shuài lǐng jūn duì shōu fù le bù fen tǔ dì chén zhòng dǎ jī le jīn jūn zhǔ lì

sentences.simplified: 在岳飞第四次北伐时，宰相秦桧在宋高宗的默许下，
sentences.traditional: 在岳飛第四次北伐時，宰相秦檜在宋高宗的默許下，
sentences.pinyin: zài yuè fēi dì sì cì běi fá shí zǎi xiàng qín huì zài sòng gāo zōng de mò xǔ xià
sentences.english: Even in such circumstances, Yue Fei still led the army to recover some territory, dealing a heavy blow to the main forces of the Jin army.

sentences.simplified: 接连下诏召回岳飞。
sentences.traditional: 接連下詔召回岳飛。
sentences.pinyin: jiē lián xià zhào zhào huí yuè fēi
sentences.english: During Yue Fei’s fourth northern expedition, Prime Minister Qin Hui, with the tacit approval of Emperor Gaozong of Song, ..

sentences.simplified: 随后编造罪名，诬陷他谋反。
sentences.traditional: 隨後編造罪名，誣陷他謀反。
sentences.pinyin: suí hòu biān zào zuì míng wū xiàn tā móu fǎn
sentences.english: .. repeatedly issued edicts to recall Yue Fei.

sentences.simplified: 岳飞拒不认罪，于狱中被冤杀，年仅39岁。
sentences.traditional: 岳飛拒不認罪，於獄中被冤殺，年僅39歲。
sentences.pinyin: yuè fēi jù bú rèn zuì yú yù zhōng bèi yuān shā nián jǐn 3 suì
sentences.english: Subsequently, they fabricated charges and falsely accused him of plotting rebellion.

sentences.simplified: 岳飞死后，南宋抗金力量遭受重创，
sentences.traditional: 岳飛死後，南宋抗金力量遭受重創，
sentences.pinyin: yuè fēi sǐ hòu nán sòng kàng jīn lì liàng zāo shòu zhòng chuāng
sentences.english: Yue Fei refused to confess to any crime and was wrongfully killed in prison at the age of only thirty-nine.

sentences.simplified: 从此再也没能大规模收回北宋失去的领土。
sentences.traditional: 從此再也沒能大規模收回北宋失去的領土。
sentences.pinyin: cóng cǐ zài yě méi néng dà guī mó shōu huí běi sòng shī qù de lǐng tǔ
sentences.english: After Yue Fei’s death, the Southern Song resistance against the Jin suffered a severe blow.
From then on, it was never able to reclaim the territories lost by the Northern Song on a large scale.

sentences.simplified: 这就是岳飞的一生，
sentences.traditional: 這就是岳飛的一生，
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì yuè fēi de yì shēng

sentences.simplified: 后人将他视为英雄，将杀害他的直接凶手秦桧视为民族罪人。
sentences.traditional: 後人將他視為英雄，將殺害他的直接兇手秦檜視為民族罪人。
sentences.pinyin: hòu rén jiāng tā shì wéi yīng xióng jiāng shā hài tā de zhí jiē xiōng shǒu qín huì shì wéi mín zú zuì rén
sentences.english: This was the life of Yue Fei.

sentences.simplified: 西湖岳王庙前那四个罪人的跪像，为首的就是秦桧。
sentences.traditional: 西湖岳王廟前那四個罪人的跪像，為首的就是秦檜。
sentences.pinyin: xī hú yuè wáng miào qián nà sì ge zuì rén de guì xiàng wéi shǒu de jiù shì qín huì
sentences.english: Later generations regarded him as a hero, while Qin Hui, the man directly responsible for his death, was condemned as a national traitor.

sentences.simplified: 但事实上岳飞之死并不是秦桧与岳飞的个人恩怨，
sentences.traditional: 但事實上岳飛之死並不是秦檜與岳飛的個人恩怨，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì shí shàng yuè fēi zhī sǐ bìng bú shì qín huì yǔ yuè fēi de gè rén ēn yuàn
sentences.english: Among the four kneeling statues of traitors in front of the Yue Fei Temple at West Lake, the foremost one is Qin Hui.

sentences.simplified: 而是南宋政治斗争的产物。
sentences.traditional: 而是南宋政治鬥爭的產物。
sentences.pinyin: ér shì nán sòng zhèng zhì dòu zhēng de chǎn wù
sentences.english: In fact, the death of Yue Fei was not due to personal grievances between Qin Hui and Yue Fei.

sentences.simplified: 在国家危难之时，皇帝将个人利益置于民族利益之上，
sentences.traditional: 在國家危難之時，皇帝將個人利益置於民族利益之上，
sentences.pinyin: zài guó jiā wēi nàn zhī shí huáng dì jiāng gè rén lì yì zhì yú mín zú lì yì zhī shàng
sentences.english: Instead, it was a product of the political struggles in the Southern Song dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 这种选择使南宋失去了复兴的机会，为后来的灭亡埋下了隐患。
sentences.traditional: 這種選擇使南宋失去了復興的機會，為後來的滅亡埋下了隱患。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng xuǎn zé shǐ nán sòng shī qù le fù xīng de jī huì wèi hòu lái de miè wáng mái xià le yǐn huàn
sentences.english: In a time of national crisis, the emperor placed personal interests above the national interest.

sentence_translations: The Death of Yue Fei: The End of the Southern Song’s Dream of Revival
The landscape of West Lake in Hangzhou is picturesque and greatly loved by the people.
In addition, the area is home to many historical sites, including four particularly notable statues.
The four statues have their hands tied behind their backs and are kneeling before the Yue Fei Temple by West Lake.
The Yue Fei Temple commemorates a national hero of the Southern Song dynasty, Yue Fei.
Statues were made of those who had caused his death, serving as a gesture of repentance before him.
Yue Fei was born at the end of the Northern Song dynasty.
From a young age, he studied martial arts and military strategy, and he was generous and benevolent in character.
At the age of twenty, Yue Fei enlisted in the army and took part in campaigns to eliminate bandit forces.
He displayed bravery and achieved his first military success.
However, not long after, his father passed away, and he left the army to return home and observe mourning for his father.
Two years later, he returned to the army. The following year, the Jin dynasty in the north invaded the Song dynasty.
The army in which Yue Fei was serving broke through the Jin army’s encirclement.
Afterward, he returned to his hometown and saw with his own eyes the people being killed and enslaved by the invaders.
Filled with anger, Yue Fei resolved to devote himself to saving the nation.
However, he was also worried that there would be no one to take care of his wife, children, and parents at home.
His mother encouraged him to set aside personal interests and dedicate himself to serving the country.
She even tattooed the four characters “serve the country with utmost loyalty” on his back.
Yue Fei returned to the army, performed exceptionally well, and gradually became a well-known general.
The Jin army marched all the way south.
In 1127, the Jin army invaded the Song capital of Bianjing and captured the emperor from the imperial palace.
The Northern Song dynasty, after 167 years of existence, came to an end.
The emperor’s younger brother, Zhao Gou, established a new regime in Shangqiu, Henan, ..
.. marking the beginning of the 152-year history of the Southern Song dynasty.
Zhao Gou was Emperor Gaozong of Song.
The territory of the Southern Song was much smaller than that of the Northern Song, ..
.. with only the land south of the Yangtze River remaining.
Yue Fei’s lifelong wish was to recover the lost territories of the Northern Song and restore the unity of the Song dynasty.
He strongly advocated resistance against the Jin and led numerous northern campaigns, fighting fierce battles against their forces.
To strengthen the army’s combat effectiveness, Yue Fei trained a force known as the “Yue Family Army.”
The Yue Family Army was strictly disciplined, never disturbed the common people, ..
.. and was able to defend the nation’s borders, earning high esteem among the populace.
However, Emperor Gaozong of Song did not want generals to have too much power, so he prepared to reclaim military authority.
But Yue Fei hoped the emperor would first allow him to recover the lost northern territories, which made the emperor feel insecure.
On the other hand, some civil officials of the Southern Song dynasty advocated abandoning the lost northern territories ..
.. and paying tribute to the Jin dynasty in exchange for peace.
Emperor Gaozong of Song was caught in a dilemma, repeatedly changing policies, and was indecisive about Yue Fei’s northern expedition.
Even in such circumstances, Yue Fei still led the army to recover some territory, dealing a heavy blow to the main forces of the Jin army.
During Yue Fei’s fourth northern expedition, Prime Minister Qin Hui, with the tacit approval of Emperor Gaozong of Song, ..
.. repeatedly issued edicts to recall Yue Fei.
Subsequently, they fabricated charges and falsely accused him of plotting rebellion.
Yue Fei refused to confess to any crime and was wrongfully killed in prison at the age of only thirty-nine.
After Yue Fei’s death, the Southern Song resistance against the Jin suffered a severe blow.
From then on, it was never able to reclaim the territories lost by the Northern Song on a large scale.
This was the life of Yue Fei.
Later generations regarded him as a hero, while Qin Hui, the man directly responsible for his death, was condemned as a national traitor.
Among the four kneeling statues of traitors in front of the Yue Fei Temple at West Lake, the foremost one is Qin Hui.
In fact, the death of Yue Fei was not due to personal grievances between Qin Hui and Yue Fei.
Instead, it was a product of the political struggles in the Southern Song dynasty.
In a time of national crisis, the emperor placed personal interests above the national interest.
This choice cost the Southern Song dynasty its opportunity for revival and sowed the seeds for its eventual downfall.
